sections.title_en: Introduction

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Carbon Emissions Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI S&C’s)1 outputs are determined. Carbon Emissions is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the carbon intensity of their operations and their efforts to manage climate-related risks and opportunities.
blocks.content_cn: 本文档提供碳排放关键议题组成部分的基本信息，帮助ESG评级用户理解MSCI可持续与气候（MSCI S&C）研究输出的确定方式。碳排放是MSCI ESG评级模型中环境支柱下的一个关键议题。公司评估内容包括其运营的碳强度以及管理气候相关风险和机遇的努力。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: • Increased costs linked to carbon pricing or trading.
blocks.content_cn: • 与碳定价或碳交易相关的成本上升。

blocks.content: • Facility retrofit costs or operational disruptions due to regulatory caps.
blocks.content_cn: • 因监管上限导致的设施改造费用或运营中断。

sections.title_en: Carbon Emissions Key Issue score

blocks.content: The Carbon Emissions Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.

sections.title_en: Carbon Emissions Mitigation score

blocks.content: The Carbon Emissions Mitigation score evaluates the company’s ability to manage and reduce carbon emissions through mitigation measures, including energy efficiency, cleaner energy use, carbon capture, demand-side management and other reduction efforts. Highest performance reflects aggressive, comprehensive programs across operations and value chain. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 碳排放减缓得分评估公司通过减缓措施管理和减少碳排放的能力，包括能源效率、清洁能源使用、碳捕集、需求侧管理及其他减排努力。最高表现反映在运营和价值链中采取积极、全面的方案。该得分以0-10分表示，10分表示强有力的举措。

sections.title_en: • Use of cleaner sources of energy.

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses how aggressively the company has sought to mitigate its carbon emissions through the use of cleaner sources of energy such as solar, wind, geothermal, co-generation, or natural gas in place of oil or coal.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司通过使用更清洁的能源来源（如太阳能、风能、地热能、热电联产，或用天然气替代石油或煤炭）积极减缓碳排放的程度。

sections.title_en: • Efforts to capture GHG emissions.

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the aggressiveness of a company’s efforts to use greenhouse gas (GHG) capture and storage/sequestration of its operational emissions.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司对运营排放采用温室气体（GHG）捕集和封存/固存的积极程度。

sections.title_en: • Energy Consumption Management & Operational Efficiency

blocks.content: Definition: This data point indicates our assessment of how aggressively the company has sought to mitigate its carbon emissions by managing energy consumption and improving the energy efficiency of its operations. Possible values are: 'Aggressive efforts' (best); 'Some efforts'; 'Limited efforts/information'; 'No efforts' (worst)
blocks.content_cn: 定义：该数据点反映我们对公司通过管理能源消耗和提高运营能效来积极减缓碳排放的评估。可能取值为：'积极努力'（最佳）；'部分努力'；'有限努力/信息不足'；'没有努力'（最差）。

sections.title_en: • Efforts to reduce customer energy consumption (demand-side management)

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates MSCI ESG Research's assessment of the aggressiveness of a company's efforts to reduce future energy consumption through energy efficiency or demand response programs. This indicator is specifically relevant for energy companies and utilities.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映MSCI ESG研究对公司通过能效或需求响应项目减少未来能源消耗的努力程度的评估。该指标对能源公司和公用事业公司特别相关。

sections.title_en: • Other efforts to reduce carbon emissions.

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses how aggressively the company has sought to mitigate its operational and/or value chain carbon emissions through other efforts (including purchasing carbon offsets, but excluding energy efficiency, clean energy use, carbon capture or demand-side management). The assessment is based on industry-specific criteria.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司通过其他方式（包括购买碳抵消，但不包括能效、清洁能源使用、碳捕集或需求侧管理）积极减缓运营和/或价值链碳排放的程度。评估基于行业特定标准。

sections.title_en: Carbon Emissions Targets score

blocks.content: The Carbon Emissions Targets score evaluates the company’s initiatives to set, pursue, and verify carbon emissions targets. Highest initiatives reflect comprehensive, independently verified targets with strong progress toward achievement. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 碳排放目标得分评估公司设定、推进并验证碳减排目标的举措。最高举措反映为全面、经独立验证且取得良好进展的目标。该得分以0-10分表示，10分表示强有力的举措。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company has established quantitative climate targets that are comprehensive in scope and complete in coverage. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating comprehensive targets.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司建立的量化气候目标在范围和覆盖面上的全面程度。以0-10分表示，10分表示目标全面。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions target footprint coverage (%)

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company’s emission reduction targets cover its total reported emissions. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates that the targets comprehensively cover all relevant emissions.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司减排目标覆盖其总报告排放量的程度。以0-10分表示，10分表示目标全面覆盖所有相关排放。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions target relevant scope score

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses whether the company’s emission reduction targets include all financially material scopes. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates full coverage of financially material emission scopes.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司减排目标是否涵盖所有财务重要范围的排放。以0-10分表示，10分表示完全覆盖财务重要排放范围。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions target progress

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward active environmental targets, as well as its historical track record in meeting previously stated targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong progress towards targets
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司实现现行环境目标的进展，以及其达成先前设定目标的历史记录。以0-10分表示，10分表示向目标取得良好进展。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions ongoing target progress

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward achieving its emission reduction targets based on current performance. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 all its targets are on track to meet stated targets.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：基于当前表现评估公司实现减排目标的进展。以0-10分表示，10分表示所有目标均在按计划实现。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions target track record

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s historical performance in achieving or maintaining sustainability or environmental targets. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司在实现或维持可持续发展/环境目标方面的历史表现。以0-10分表示，10分表示表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions target verification

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses whether the company’s disclosed targets are supported by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), where applicable. Expressed as either NULL or 10 score, with 10 indicating presence of verification.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司披露的目标是否得到科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）（如适用）的支持。取值为NULL或10分，10分表示已获验证。

sections.title_en: • SBTi long-term target status

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) long-term target, aligned with net-zero or long-term decarbonization goals.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）长期目标的状态，该目标与净零或长期脱碳目标保持一致。

sections.title_en: • SBTi near-term target status

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) near-term target, aligned with short- to medium-term emissions reduction goals.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）近期目标的状态，该目标与短期至中期减排目标保持一致。

sections.title_en: Carbon Emissions Performance score

blocks.content: The Carbon Emissions Performance score evaluates the company's performance on carbon emissions metrics (including greenhouse gas emissions intensity), relative to its peers. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 碳排放绩效得分评估公司在碳排放指标（包括温室气体排放强度）上相对于同行的表现。以0-10分表示，10分表示表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions performance relative to peers.

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on greenhouse gas [GHG] emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), and trend in GHG emissions intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司在温室气体（GHG）排放强度（按销售额或产量归一化）及其趋势方面相对于同行的表现。以0-10分表示，10分表示表现强劲。

sections.title_en: ◦ Carbon emissions intensity industry relative score

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on greenhouse gas [GHG] emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司在温室气体（GHG）排放强度（按销售额或产量归一化）方面相对于同行的表现。以0-10分表示，10分表示表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Three-year average carbon emissions intensity (sales based)

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average greenhouse-gas emissions per unit of sales over the defined period.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司在定义期间内每单位销售额的三年平均温室气体排放量。

sections.title_en: • Three-year average carbon emissions intensity (production based)

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average greenhouse-gas emissions per unit production (megawatt-hour generated, or ton cement produced or revenue passenger kilometer, based on industry).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司每单位产量的三年平均温室气体排放量（按行业不同，可为每兆瓦时发电量、每吨水泥产量或每收入客公里）。

sections.title_en: ◦ Carbon emissions intensity industry relative trend score

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year carbon-emissions intensity trend (normalized by sales or by units of production), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司三年平均温室气体排放强度同比变化趋势（按销售额或产量归一化）相对于同行的表现。以0-10分表示，10分表示表现强劲。

sections.title_en: Three-year average year-over-year carbon emissions intensity trend (sales based)

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year greenhouse-gas emissions (per unit of sales) trend.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司每单位销售额温室气体排放的三年平均同比变化趋势。

sections.title_en: Three-year average year-over-year carbon emissions intensity trend (production based)

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average year-over-year greenhousegas emissions per unit production (megawatt-hour generated, or ton cement produced or revenue passenger kilometer based on industry) trend.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司每单位产量温室气体排放（按行业不同，可为每兆瓦时发电量、每吨水泥产量或每收入客公里）的三年平均同比变化趋势。

blocks.content: Sources: Company disclosures, CDP
blocks.content_cn: 数据来源：公司披露、CDP（碳披露项目）

sections.title_en: Carbon Emissions Exposure score

blocks.content: The Carbon Emissions Exposure score evaluates the company’s exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Geographic Exposure scores. The Geographic Exposure score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business and Geographic Exposure scores are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to Section 3.2, Analyzing risk exposure, of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 碳排放敞口得分评估公司对该关键议题风险的敞口程度。它基于业务敞口得分和地理敞口得分计算。地理敞口得分作为业务敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为-50%至+50%。业务敞口得分和地理敞口得分均按0-10分制评分，10分对应最高风险，0分对应最低风险。更多细节请参阅《ESG评级方法论》第3.2节"风险敞口分析"。敞口得分按以下公式计算：

blocks.content:
$$
E X P _ { C B N , i } = B U S _ { C B N , i } ( 1 + 0 . 1 \big ( G E O _ { C B N , i } - 5 \big ) )
$$

sections.title_en: Business Segment Exposure scores

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. Each business activity score is determined by aggregating normalized Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions intensities to a business activity level.
blocks.content_cn: 业务板块敞口得分基于公司披露的业务板块与相应业务活动的映射确定。MSCI S&C使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系并结合行业特定调整来定义业务活动。与业务活动相关的得分用于计算业务板块敞口得分。每项业务活动得分通过将归一化的范围1和范围2温室气体排放强度汇总到业务活动层面确定。

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: $E I _ { j , S 1 + S 2 }$ is the Emissions Intensity score for the business activity j aggregated from companylevel data assessed by MSCI.
blocks.content_cn: $EI_{j,S1+S2}$ 是业务活动j的排放强度得分，由MSCI评估的公司层面数据汇总得出。

blocks.content: The Emissions Intensity score indicates the baseline risk faced by a business segment. For each SIC code, this score is calculated by considering the reported company level scopes 1 and 2 emissions.
blocks.content_cn: 排放强度得分反映业务板块面临的基线风险。对于每个SIC代码，该得分通过考虑公司报告的范围1和范围2排放计算得出。

blocks.content: To calculate the score:
blocks.content_cn: 计算方法：

blocks.content: 1. For each SIC code, the median emissions intensity is computed using data from companies that have majority of their assets value from activities mapped to that SIC code.
blocks.content_cn: 1. 对于每个SIC代码，使用主要资产价值来自映射到该SIC代码业务活动的公司数据计算排放强度中位数。

blocks.content: Emissions intensity is expressed as metric tons of $\mathsf { C O } _ { 2 }$ equivalent $( \mathsf { m t C O } _ { 2 } { \mathsf { e } } )$ per million USD in sales.
blocks.content_cn: 排放强度以每百万美元销售额的CO2当量公吨数（mtCO2e）表示。

blocks.content: 2. If no company derives more than 50% of its revenue from the activities mapped to a specific SIC code, the calculation defaults to the next broader level in the SIC code hierarchy.
blocks.content_cn: 2. 如果没有公司超过50%的收入来自映射到特定SIC代码的业务活动，则计算回退到SIC代码层级中下一个更宽的层级。

blocks.content: 3. The resulting emissions intensity per business segment is then log-transformed and scaled to a 0–10 range, where higher scores indicate greater emissions intensity and baseline carbon emissions exposure.
blocks.content_cn: 3. 每个业务板块的排放强度经对数变换后缩放到0-10范围，分数越高表示排放强度越大、基线碳排放敞口越高。

blocks.content: For business activities related to electricity transmission and distribution (T&D) and power generation, the Business Segment Exposure score is derived by aggregating the emissions intensities of pure-play T&D companies as assessed by MSCI.
blocks.content_cn: 对于与输电和配电（T&D）以及发电相关的业务活动，业务板块敞口得分通过汇总MSCI评估的纯T&D公司的排放强度得出。

blocks.content: The fossil fuel subsidies score indicates the degree of financial support for fossil fuel consumption. Lower subsidies (higher scores) increase transition pressure by removing cost advantages, whereas high subsidies (lower scores) signal continued alignment with fossil fuel-based economic structures, thus reducing policy pressure

MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Carbon Emissions Key Issue ## Contents Introduction.. 3 Risks associated with this Key Issue 4 Carbon Emissions Key Issue score . 4 Carbon Emissions Management framework .... 4 Carbon Emissions Management score .... 5 Carbon Emissions Mitigation score.. .6 Carbon Emissions Targets score.... . 7 Carbon Emissions Performance score . .8 Carbon Emissions Exposure score...... . 9 Business Exposure score.. . 10 Business Segment Exposure scores.... . 11 Geographic Exposure score ... . 12 Geographic Segment Exposure scores.... 12 Data sources... . 13 Contact us.. .14 ## Introduction This document provides essential information on the components of the Carbon Emissions Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI S&C’s)1 outputs are determined. Carbon Emissions is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the carbon intensity of their operations and their efforts to manage climate-related risks and opportunities. For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.” Exhibit 1: MSCI ESG Key Issue hierarchy

## Risks associated with this Key Issue • Increased costs linked to carbon pricing or trading. • Facility retrofit costs or operational disruptions due to regulatory caps. ## Carbon Emissions Key Issue score The Carbon Emissions Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score. $$ K I _ { i } = 7 - ( \operatorname* { m a x } { ( E X P _ { i } , 2 ) } - M G M T _ { i } ) $$ Where: $K I _ { i }$ is the Key Issue score for company i. $E X P _ { i }$ is the Exposure score for company i. $MGMT_i$ is the Management score for company i. ## Carbon Emissions Management framework The table below outlines the indicators mapped to their respective components that inform the Carbon Emissions Management score, excluding controversies. MSCI S&C assigns each indicator a default weight. Indicator weights may be adjusted at the company level to reflect the relevance of the indicator to the company’s business activities. If a company has no exposure to the business activities covered by an indicator, the indicator is assigned a weight of zero.

Carbon emissions target progress

## Carbon Emissions Management score The Carbon Emissions Management score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on weighted average of the scores associated with each of the relevant indicator, modified by controversies. This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated. The following formula is used to calculate the Carbon Emissions Management score - Excluding Controversies: $$ M G M T _ { i } = \ \sum I n d i c a t o r \_ S c o r e _ { j , i } \ast I n d i c a t o r \_ W e i g h t _ { j , i } $$ Where: $M G M T _ { i }$ is the Management score - Excluding Controversies for company i. $Indicator\_Score_{j,i}$ is the score of indicator j for company i. $Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$ is the weight of indicator j for company i. The following formula is used to calculate the scores for the components $$ C O M P _ { c , i } = \sum _ { j \in c } I n d i c a t o r \_ S c o r e _ { j , i } * I n d i c a t o r \_ W e i g h t \_ S c a l e d _ { j , i } $$ Where: $C O M P _ { c , i }$ is the component score for component $c _ { \prime }$ for company i. $Indicator\_Score_{j,i}$ is the score of indicator j for company i. $Indicator\_Weight\_Scaled_{j,i}$ is the scaled weight of indicator j for company i. $j \in c$ indicates that the summation is over all indicators belonging to component The following formula is used to calculate the weights for the components $$ C O M P \_ W e i g h t _ { c , i } = \sum _ { j \in c } I n d i c a t o r \_ W e i g h t _ { j , i } $$ Where: $C O M P \_ W e i g h t _ { c , i }$ is the component weight for component for company i. $Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$ is the weight of indicator j for company i. $j \in c$ indicates that the summation is over all indicators belonging to component . The definitions of the data points in each component are given below: ## Carbon Emissions Mitigation score The Carbon Emissions Mitigation score evaluates the company’s ability to manage and reduce carbon emissions through mitigation measures, including energy efficiency, cleaner energy use, carbon capture, demand-side management and other reduction efforts. Highest performance reflects aggressive, comprehensive programs across operations and value chain. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives. ## • Use of cleaner sources of energy. Definition: Assesses how aggressively the company has sought to mitigate its carbon emissions through the use of cleaner sources of energy such as solar, wind, geothermal, co-generation, or natural gas in place of oil or coal. ## • Efforts to capture GHG emissions. Definition: Assesses the aggressiveness of a company’s efforts to use greenhouse gas (GHG) capture and storage/sequestration of its operational emissions. ## • Energy Consumption Management & Operational Efficiency Definition: This data point indicates our assessment of how aggressively the company has sought to mitigate its carbon emissions by managing energy consumption and improving the energy efficiency of its operations. Possible values are: 'Aggressive efforts' (best); 'Some efforts'; 'Limited efforts/information'; 'No efforts' (worst) ## • Efforts to reduce customer energy consumption (demand-side management) Definition: Indicates MSCI ESG Research's assessment of the aggressiveness of a company's efforts to reduce future energy consumption through energy efficiency or demand response programs. This indicator is specifically relevant for energy companies and utilities. ## • Other efforts to reduce carbon emissions. Definition: Assesses how aggressively the company has sought to mitigate its operational and/or value chain carbon emissions through other efforts (including purchasing carbon offsets, but excluding energy efficiency, clean energy use, carbon capture or demand-side management). The assessment is based on industry-specific criteria. ## Carbon Emissions Targets score The Carbon Emissions Targets score evaluates the company’s initiatives to set, pursue, and verify carbon emissions targets. Highest initiatives reflect comprehensive, independently verified targets with strong progress toward achievement. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives. ## • Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company has established quantitative climate targets that are comprehensive in scope and complete in coverage. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating comprehensive targets. ## • Carbon emissions target footprint coverage (%) Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company’s emission reduction targets cover its total reported emissions. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates that the targets comprehensively cover all relevant emissions. ## • Carbon emissions target relevant scope score Definition: Assesses whether the company’s emission reduction targets include all financially material scopes. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates full coverage of financially material emission scopes. ## • Carbon emissions target progress Definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward active environmental targets, as well as its historical track record in meeting previously stated targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong progress towards targets ## • Carbon emissions ongoing target progress Definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward achieving its emission reduction targets based on current performance. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 all its targets are on track to meet stated targets. ## • Carbon emissions target track record Definition: Assesses the company’s historical performance in achieving or maintaining sustainability or environmental targets. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance. ## • Carbon emissions target verification Definition: Assesses whether the company’s disclosed targets are supported by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), where applicable. Expressed as either NULL or 10 score, with 10 indicating presence of verification. ## • SBTi long-term target status Definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) long-term target, aligned with net-zero or long-term decarbonization goals. ## • SBTi near-term target status Definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) near-term target, aligned with short- to medium-term emissions reduction goals. ## Carbon Emissions Performance score The Carbon Emissions Performance score evaluates the company's performance on carbon emissions metrics (including greenhouse gas emissions intensity), relative to its peers. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance. ## • Carbon emissions performance relative to peers. Definition: Assesses the company's performance on greenhouse gas [GHG] emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), and trend in GHG emissions intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance. ## ◦ Carbon emissions intensity industry relative score Definition: Assesses the company's performance on greenhouse gas [GHG] emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance. ## • Three-year average carbon emissions intensity (sales based) Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average greenhouse-gas emissions per unit of sales over the defined period. ## • Three-year average carbon emissions intensity (production based) Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average greenhouse-gas emissions per unit production (megawatt-hour generated, or ton cement produced or revenue passenger kilometer, based on industry). ## ◦ Carbon emissions intensity industry relative trend score Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year carbon-emissions intensity trend (normalized by sales or by units of production), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance. ## Three-year average year-over-year carbon emissions intensity trend (sales based) Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year greenhouse-gas emissions (per unit of sales) trend. ## Three-year average year-over-year carbon emissions intensity trend (production based) Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average year-over-year greenhousegas emissions per unit production (megawatt-hour generated, or ton cement produced or revenue passenger kilometer based on industry) trend. Sources: Company disclosures, CDP ## Carbon Emissions Exposure score The Carbon Emissions Exposure score evaluates the company’s exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Geographic Exposure scores. The Geographic Exposure score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business and Geographic Exposure scores are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to Section 3.2, Analyzing risk exposure, of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure score calculation: $$ E X P _ { C B N , i } = B U S _ { C B N , i } ( 1 + 0 . 1 \big ( G E O _ { C B N , i } - 5 \big ) ) $$ ## Where: $E X P _ { C B N , i }$ is the Carbon Emissions Exposure score of company i. $B U S _ { C B N , i }$ is the Business Exposure score of company i. $G E O _ { C B N , i }$ is the Geographic Exposure score of company i. Exhibit 2: Exposure score components Carbon Emissions Exposure score Business Exposure score Business Segment Exposure scores GHG Emissions Intensity Geographic Exposure score Geographic Segment Exposure scores Annual Reduction in Carbon Emissions to Meet Emission Targets, Net Zero targets, Fossil Fuel Subsidies, Carbon Pricing ## Business Exposure score The Business Exposure score is a weighted average of the Business Segment Exposure scores of a company’s business segments. Scores are weighted by the proportion of a company’s total assets in each business segment,2 using the following formula to calculate the Business Exposure score: $$ B U S _ { C B N , i } = \sum _ { j = 1 } ^ { n _ { i } } w _ { A s s e t , i , j } B S E _ { C B N , j } $$ Where: $B S E _ { C B N , j }$ is the Business Segment Exposure score for the business segment j. $w _ { A s s e t , i , j }$ is the weight of business segment j for company i based on the contribution to total company assets. $n _ { i }$ is the number of business segments of company i. ## Business Segment Exposure scores The Business Segment Exposure score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. Each business activity score is determined by aggregating normalized Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions intensities to a business activity level. $$ B S E _ { C B N , j } = \ E I _ { j , S 1 + S 2 } $$ Where: $E I _ { j , S 1 + S 2 }$ is the Emissions Intensity score for the business activity j aggregated from companylevel data assessed by MSCI. The Emissions Intensity score indicates the baseline risk faced by a business segment. For each SIC code, this score is calculated by considering the reported company level scopes 1 and 2 emissions. To calculate the score: 1. For each SIC code, the median emissions intensity is computed using data from companies that have majority of their assets value from activities mapped to that SIC code. Emissions intensity is expressed as metric tons of $\mathsf { C O } _ { 2 }$ equivalent $( \mathsf { m t C O } _ { 2 } { \mathsf { e } } )$ per million USD in sales. 2. If no company derives more than 50% of its revenue from the activities mapped to a specific SIC code, the calculation defaults to the next broader level in the SIC code hierarchy. 3. The resulting emissions intensity per business segment is then log-transformed and scaled to a 0–10 range, where higher scores indicate greater emissions intensity and baseline carbon emissions exposure. For business activities related to electricity transmission and distribution (T&D) and power generation, the Business Segment Exposure score is derived by aggregating the emissions intensities of pure-play T&D companies as assessed by MSCI. $$ B S E _ { C B N , j } = E I _ { j , M S C I } $$ ## Geographic Exposure score The Geographic Exposure score is a weighted average of the Geographic Segment Exposure scores of the countries, markets and regions in which a company operates. scores are weighted by the proportion of a company’s total assets in each geographic segment using the following equation: $$ G E O _ { C B N , i } = \sum _ { r = 1 } ^ { n _ { i } } w _ { A s s e t , i , r } G S E _ { C B N , r } $$ Where: $G S E _ { C B N , r }$ is the Geographic Segment Exposure score in region . $w _ { A s s e t , i , r }$ is the weight of total assets in region r for company i. $n _ { i }$ is the number of geographic segments for company i. For geographic segments reported as regions (example: Asia Pacific), a nominal GDP-weighted country or market aggregation is used to calculate region-level scores, using the following equation: $$ G S E _ { C B N , r } = \sum _ { c = 1 } ^ { n _ { r } } w _ { G D P , r , c } G S E _ { C B N , c } $$ Where: $G S E _ { C B N , c }$ is the Geographic Segment Exposure score of country or market . $w _ { G D P , r , c }$ is the specific weight of country or market within region . ## Geographic Segment Exposure scores The Geographic Segment Exposure score for a country is determined by looking at the annual reduction in greenhouse gas emissions required to meet its publicly disclosed greenhouse gas emission targets. $$ G S E _ { C B N , c } = A v g ( N T A _ { c } , L T A _ { c } , G M M _ { c } ) $$ Where: $N T A _ { c } ,$ is the near-term ambition score of country or market . $L T A _ { c }$ is the long-term ambition score of country or market . $G M M _ { c }$ is the government and market mechanisms score of country or market . The near-term ambition of a country is assessed by considering the annual emissions reduction rate needed to meet their publicly disclosed near-term climate targets. Countries or markets with aggressive near-term targets have high emissions reduction rates and therefore a higher policy pressure segment score. A country or market’s long-term ambition indicates the strength and credibility of its long-term climate targets such as net-zero commitments. Long term targets could signal the direction of future policy and regulatory developments, even in the near term. The government and market mechanisms score indicates the current strength of policy and marketbased mechanisms signaling a government’s commitment to driving the energy transition. This score is calculated as the average of carbon pricing score and fossil fuel subsidies score. $$ G M M _ { c } = A v g \left( \mathit { C P M } , \mathit { F F S } \right) $$ ## Where Carbon Pricing Mechanisms score Fossil Fuel Subsidies score. Carbon pricing mechanisms score indicates mechanisms such as carbon taxes or emissions trading systems that exert policy pressure on companies by assigning a direct cost to carbon emissions. The fossil fuel subsidies score indicates the degree of financial support for fossil fuel consumption. Lower subsidies (higher scores) increase transition pressure by removing cost advantages, whereas high subsidies (lower scores) signal continued alignment with fossil fuel-based economic structures, thus reducing policy pressure In the absence of evidence from data sources indicating that a country has near- or long-term emissions reduction targets or carbon pricing mechanisms in place, a score of 0 is assigned. In the absence of a country’s fossil fuel subsidy information, a score of 5 is assigned. ## Data sources The following sources are used to determine the Carbon Emissions Exposure score: Refinitiv; IMF Implied Mitigation Targets, Net Zero Tracker, Carbon Pricing Dashboard, IMF Fossil Fuel Subsidies Data, International Energy Agency (2020), Projected Costs of Generating Electricity 2020;; GHG emissions intensities compiled by MSCI S&C; company disclosures. ## Contact us ## About MSCI Inc. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. sections.title_en: Introduction

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Product Carbon Footprint Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI’s),1 outputs are determined. Product Carbon Footprint is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the carbon intensity of their products and their ability to reduce the carbon footprint in their supply chains or in the use of their products and services.
blocks.content_cn: 本文档提供产品碳足迹关键议题组成部分的基本信息，帮助ESG评级用户理解MSCI可持续与气候（MSCI）研究输出的确定方式。产品碳足迹是MSCI ESG评级模型中环境支柱下的一个关键议题。公司评估内容包括其产品的碳强度，以及其在供应链中或产品和服务使用过程中减少碳足迹的能力。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: • Increased costs from higher and more volatile energy prices upstream in the value chain (affecting raw materials, input, and distribution costs).

blocks.content_cn: • 与下游排放相关的监管风险，例如汽车行业因车队排放标准不达标而产生的处罚。

sections.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint Key Issue score

blocks.content: The Product Carbon Footprint Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score on this Key Issue is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.

sections.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint Management score

blocks.content: The Product Carbon Footprint Management score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on weighted average of the score associated with each relevant indicators, modified by controversies.
blocks.content_cn: 产品碳足迹管理得分评估公司管理该关键议题风险敞口的能力。它基于各相关指标得分的加权平均值计算，并经争议事件调整。

blocks.content: This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated.

blocks.content: The definitions of the data points in each component are given below:
blocks.content_cn: 各组成部分中数据点的定义如下：

sections.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint Practices score

blocks.content: The Product Carbon Footprint Practices score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks related to the carbon intensity of its products and its ability to reduce the carbon footprint in its supply chains or in the use of its products and services. This score is equal to the Product Carbon Footprint Management score and considers attributes of the company's policies and initiatives. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 产品碳足迹实践得分评估公司管理与产品碳强度相关风险敞口的能力，以及其在供应链中或产品和服务使用过程中减少碳足迹的能力。该得分等于产品碳足迹管理得分，并考虑公司政策和举措的属性。以0-10分表示，10分表示强有力的举措。

sections.title_en: • Assessment of energy consumption and/or carbon emissions of suppliers

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions and/or energy consumption of its suppliers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否评估其供应商的碳排放和/或能源消耗。

sections.title_en: • Extent of product carbon footprint assessments

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the downstream carbon emissions of its products and services.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否评估其产品和服务的下游碳排放。

sections.title_en: • Targets to reduce Scope 3 upstream carbon emissions

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there is evidence the company has quantitative and time-bound targets to reduce Scope 3 upstream carbon emissions. This may include targets regarding the company’s supply chain.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映是否有证据表明公司设定了减少范围3上游碳排放的量化、有时限的目标。这可能包括与公司供应链相关的目标。

sections.title_en: • Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of distribution and store operations

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its distribution centers and store operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否评估其分销中心和门店运营的碳排放或能源消耗。

sections.title_en: • Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of manufacturing operations (including suppliers)

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its manufacturing operations, including suppliers’ operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否评估其制造运营（包括供应商运营）的碳排放或能源消耗。

sections.title_en: • Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of raw materials sourcing

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the upstream carbon emissions or energy consumption involved in the production of raw materials.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否评估原材料生产过程中涉及的上游碳排放或能源消耗。

sections.title_en: • Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of transportation and logistics

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its transportation and logistics operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否评估其运输和物流运营的碳排放或能源消耗。

sections.title_en: • Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in distribution centers or store operations

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in its distribution centers or store operations. Best practice includes programs in all distribution centers or store operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在其分销中心或门店运营中实施碳减排或节能项目的程度。最佳实践包括在所有分销中心或门店运营中实施项目。

sections.title_en: • Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in manufacturing operations (including suppliers)

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in its manufacturing operations, including suppliers’ operations. Best practice includes programs covering all core production facilities.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在其制造运营（包括供应商运营）中实施碳减排或节能项目的程度。最佳实践包括项目覆盖所有核心生产设施。

sections.title_en: • Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in raw materials sourcing

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in the sourcing of raw materials, including those sourced by suppliers. Best practice includes programs covering all core products.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在原材料采购（包括供应商采购的原材料）中实施碳减排或节能项目的程度。最佳实践包括项目覆盖所有核心产品。

sections.title_en: • Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in transportation and logistics

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in the transportation and logistics stages. Best practice includes improvements in fleet efficiency combined with improvements in load/packaging optimization.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在运输和物流阶段实施碳减排或节能项目的程度。最佳实践包括车队效率提升与装载/包装优化相结合。

blocks.content: Sources: Company disclosures, CDP, International Council on Clean Transportation, Environmental Protection Agency, European Environment Agency, Korea Energy Industry.
blocks.content_cn: 数据来源：公司披露、CDP（碳披露项目）、国际清洁交通理事会、美国环保署、欧洲环境署、韩国能源产业。

sections.title_en: For the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry:

blocks.content: For companies belonging to the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry, the Product Carbon Footprint Management score is calculated using the Product Carbon Footprint Performance score and the Product Carbon Footprint Performance Targets score.
blocks.content_cn: 对于属于汽车和摩托车制造业的公司，产品碳足迹管理得分使用产品碳足迹绩效得分和产品碳足迹绩效目标得分计算。

blocks.content: The definitions of the data points in each component are given below:
blocks.content_cn: 各组成部分中数据点的定义如下：

sections.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint Performance score

blocks.content: The Product Carbon Footprint Performance score evaluates the company's performance on Product Carbon Footprint metrics, including the company’s estimated tailpipe emissions. It is expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 产品碳足迹绩效得分评估公司在产品碳足迹指标上的表现，包括公司估计的尾气排放。以0-10分表示，10分表示最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: • Tailpipe fleet emission performance relative to peers

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission performance in comparison to industry peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating lowest fleet emissions, relative to peers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司估计的全球按销量加权的尾气车队排放表现与行业同行相比的情况。以0-10分表示，10分表示相对同行车队排放最低。

sections.title_en: ◦ Product Carbon Footprint industry relative score

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates lowest fleet emissions relative to peers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司估计的全球按销量加权的尾气车队排放相对同行的表现。以0-10分表示，10分表示相对同行车队排放最低。

blocks.content: ◦ Product Carbon Footprint industry relative trend score
blocks.content_cn: ◦ 产品碳足迹行业相对趋势得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-overyear estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates highest decline in fleet emissions, relative to peers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司估计的全球按销量加权的尾气车队排放三年平均同比变化趋势相对同行的表现。以0-10分表示，10分表示相对同行车队排放下降幅度最大。

blocks.content: Sources: Company disclosures; European Environment Agency (EEA), DISCODATA Database; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), Energy and Information Data Center; U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Automotive Trends Data
blocks.content_cn: 数据来源：公司披露；欧洲环境署（EEA）DISCODATA数据库；工业和信息化部（MIIT）能源与信息数据中心；美国环保署（EPA）汽车趋势数据

sections.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint Targets score

blocks.content: The Product Carbon Footprint Targets score evaluates the company’s initiatives to set, pursue and verify carbon emissions targets. Highest initiatives reflect comprehensive, independently verified targets with strong progress toward achievement. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 产品碳足迹目标得分评估公司设定、推进并验证碳减排目标的举措。最高举措反映为全面、经独立验证且取得良好进展的目标。以0-10分表示，10分表示强有力的举措。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company has established quantitative climate targets that are comprehensive in scope and complete in coverage. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating comprehensive targets.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司建立的量化气候目标在范围和覆盖面上的全面程度。以0-10分表示，10分表示目标全面。

blocks.content: ◦ Carbon emissions target footprint coverage (%)
blocks.content_cn: ◦ 碳减排目标足迹覆盖率（%）

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company’s emission reduction targets cover its total reported emissions. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates that the targets comprehensively cover all relevant emissions.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司减排目标覆盖其总报告排放量的程度。以0-10分表示，10分表示目标全面覆盖所有相关排放。

blocks.content: ◦ Carbon emissions target relevant scope score
blocks.content_cn: ◦ 碳减排目标相关范围得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses whether the company’s emission reduction targets include all financially material scopes. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates full coverage of financially material emission scopes.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司减排目标是否涵盖所有财务重要范围的排放。以0-10分表示，10分表示完全覆盖财务重要排放范围。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions target progress

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward active environmental targets, as well as its historical track record in meeting previously stated targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong progress towards targets
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司实现现行环境目标的进展，以及其达成先前设定目标的历史记录。以0-10分表示，10分表示向目标取得良好进展。

blocks.content: ◦ Carbon emissions ongoing target progress
blocks.content_cn: ◦ 碳减排进行中目标进展

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward achieving its emission reduction targets based on current performance. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 all its targets are on track to meet stated targets.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：基于当前表现评估公司实现减排目标的进展。以0-10分表示，10分表示所有目标均在按计划实现。

blocks.content: ◦ Carbon emissions target track record
blocks.content_cn: ◦ 碳减排目标历史记录

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s historical performance in achieving or maintaining sustainability or environmental targets. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司在实现或维持可持续发展/环境目标方面的历史表现。以0-10分表示，10分表示表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions target verification

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses whether the company’s disclosed targets are supported by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), where applicable. Expressed as either NULL or 10 score, with 10 indicating presence of verification.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司披露的目标是否得到科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）（如适用）的支持。取值为NULL或10分，10分表示已获验证。

blocks.content: ◦ SBTi long-term target status
blocks.content_cn: ◦ SBTi长期目标状态

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) long-term target, aligned with net-zero or long-term decarbonization goals.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）长期目标的状态，该目标与净零或长期脱碳目标保持一致。

blocks.content: ◦ SBTi near-term target status
blocks.content_cn: ◦ SBTi近期目标状态

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) near-term target, aligned with short- to medium-term emissions reduction goals.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）近期目标的状态，该目标与短期至中期减排目标保持一致。

sections.title_en: Business Segment Exposure scores

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure score is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score.
blocks.content_cn: 业务板块敞口得分基于公司披露的业务板块与相应业务活动的映射确定。MSCI S&C使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系并结合行业特定调整来定义业务活动。与业务活动相关的得分用于计算业务板块敞口得分。

sections.title_en: For the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry:

blocks.content: Each business activity score is determined by a qualitative assessment of specific vehicle class emissions and vehicle weights in a business activity. The highest resulting Business Exposure scores correspond to the passenger vehicle classes with the highest emissions intensities and vehicle weights. Passenger vehicle classes are generally considered to face stricter regulations than commercial vehicles or two-wheelers.
blocks.content_cn: 每项业务活动得分通过对业务活动中特定车辆类别的排放和车辆重量进行定性评估来确定。业务敞口得分最高的对应乘用车类别，其排放强度和车辆重量最高。乘用车类别通常被认为比商用车或两轮车面临更严格的监管。

MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Product Carbon Footprint Key Issue ## Contents Introduction. 3 Risks associated with this Key Issue 4 Product Carbon Footprint Key Issue score.. 4 Product Carbon Footprint Management framework... 4 Product Carbon Footprint Management score... 5 Product Carbon Footprint Practices score .6 Product Carbon Footprint Performance score.. .. 9 Product Carbon Footprint Targets score . .. 9 Product Carbon Footprint Exposure score .... ..11 Business Exposure score. . 12 Business Segment Exposure scores... . 13 Geographic Exposure score . . 14 Geographic Segment Exposure scores... 15 Data sources.. . 15 Contact us. .16 ## Introduction This document provides essential information on the components of the Product Carbon Footprint Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI’s),1 outputs are determined. Product Carbon Footprint is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the carbon intensity of their products and their ability to reduce the carbon footprint in their supply chains or in the use of their products and services. For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.” Exhibit 1: MSCI ESG Key Issue hierarchy

## Risks associated with this Key Issue • Increased costs from higher and more volatile energy prices upstream in the value chain (affecting raw materials, input, and distribution costs). • Regulatory risks associated with downstream emissions, e.g., penalties resulting from vehicle fleet emissions standards in the automobile industry. ## Product Carbon Footprint Key Issue score The Product Carbon Footprint Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score on this Key Issue is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score. $$ K I _ { i } = 7 - ( \operatorname* { m a x } { ( E X P _ { i } , 2 ) } - M G M T _ { i } ) $$ Where: $K I _ { i }$ is the Key Issue score for company i. $E X P _ { i }$ is the Exposure score for company i. $M G M T _ { i }$ is the Management score for company i. ## Product Carbon Footprint Management framework The table below outlines the indicators mapped to their respective components that inform the Product Carbon Footprint Management score, excluding controversies. MSCI S&C assigns each indicator a default weight. Indicator weights may be adjusted at the company level to reflect the relevance of the indicator to the company’s business activities. If a company has no exposure to the business activities covered by an indicator, the indicator is assigned a weight of zero.

## Product Carbon Footprint Management score The Product Carbon Footprint Management score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on weighted average of the score associated with each relevant indicators, modified by controversies. This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated. The following formula is used to calculate the Product Carbon Footprint Management score - Excluding Controversies: $$ M G M T _ { i } = \ \sum I n d i c a t o r \_ S c o r e _ { j , i } \ast I n d i c a t o r \_ W e i g h t _ { j , i } $$ Where: $M G M T _ { i }$ is the Management score - Excluding Controversies for company i. $Indicator\_Score_{j,i}$ is the score of indicator j for company i. $Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$ is the weight of indicator j for company i. The following formula is used to calculate the scores for the components $$ C O M P _ { c , i } = \sum _ { j \in c } I n d i c a t o r \_ S c o r e _ { j , i } * I n d i c a t o r \_ W e i g h t \_ S c a l e d _ { j , i } $$ Where: $C O M P _ { c , i }$ is the component score for component $c _ { \prime }$ for company i. $Indicator\_Score_{j,i}$ is the score of indicator j for company i. $Indicator\_Weight\_Scaled_{j,i}$ is the scaled weight of indicator j for company i. $j \in c$ indicates that the summation is over all indicators belonging to component The following formula is used to calculate the weights for the components $$ C O M P \_ W e i g h t _ { c , i } = \sum _ { j \in c } I n d i c a t o r \_ W e i g h t _ { j , i } $$ Where: $C O M P \_ W e i g h t _ { c , i }$ is the component weight for component for company i. $Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$ is the weight of indicator j for company i. $j \in c$ indicates that the summation is over all indicators belonging to component . The definitions of the data points in each component are given below: ## Product Carbon Footprint Practices score The Product Carbon Footprint Practices score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks related to the carbon intensity of its products and its ability to reduce the carbon footprint in its supply chains or in the use of its products and services. This score is equal to the Product Carbon Footprint Management score and considers attributes of the company's policies and initiatives. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives. ## For all industries except the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry: ## • Assessment of energy consumption and/or carbon emissions of suppliers Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions and/or energy consumption of its suppliers. ## • Extent of product carbon footprint assessments Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the downstream carbon emissions of its products and services. ## • Targets to reduce Scope 3 upstream carbon emissions Definition: Indicates whether there is evidence the company has quantitative and time-bound targets to reduce Scope 3 upstream carbon emissions. This may include targets regarding the company’s supply chain. ## • Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of distribution and store operations Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its distribution centers and store operations. ## • Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of manufacturing operations (including suppliers) Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its manufacturing operations, including suppliers’ operations. ## • Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of raw materials sourcing Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the upstream carbon emissions or energy consumption involved in the production of raw materials. ## • Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of transportation and logistics Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its transportation and logistics operations. ## • Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in distribution centers or store operations Definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in its distribution centers or store operations. Best practice includes programs in all distribution centers or store operations. ## • Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in manufacturing operations (including suppliers) Definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in its manufacturing operations, including suppliers’ operations. Best practice includes programs covering all core production facilities. ## • Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in raw materials sourcing Definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in the sourcing of raw materials, including those sourced by suppliers. Best practice includes programs covering all core products. ## • Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in transportation and logistics Definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in the transportation and logistics stages. Best practice includes improvements in fleet efficiency combined with improvements in load/packaging optimization. Sources: Company disclosures, CDP, International Council on Clean Transportation, Environmental Protection Agency, European Environment Agency, Korea Energy Industry. ## For the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry: For companies belonging to the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry, the Product Carbon Footprint Management score is calculated using the Product Carbon Footprint Performance score and the Product Carbon Footprint Performance Targets score. The definitions of the data points in each component are given below: ## Product Carbon Footprint Performance score The Product Carbon Footprint Performance score evaluates the company's performance on Product Carbon Footprint metrics, including the company’s estimated tailpipe emissions. It is expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance. ## • Tailpipe fleet emission performance relative to peers Definition: Assesses the company's estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission performance in comparison to industry peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating lowest fleet emissions, relative to peers. ## ◦ Product Carbon Footprint industry relative score Definition: Assesses the company's performance on estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates lowest fleet emissions relative to peers. ◦ Product Carbon Footprint industry relative trend score Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-overyear estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates highest decline in fleet emissions, relative to peers. Sources: Company disclosures; European Environment Agency (EEA), DISCODATA Database; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), Energy and Information Data Center; U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Automotive Trends Data ## Product Carbon Footprint Targets score The Product Carbon Footprint Targets score evaluates the company’s initiatives to set, pursue and verify carbon emissions targets. Highest initiatives reflect comprehensive, independently verified targets with strong progress toward achievement. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives. ## • Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company has established quantitative climate targets that are comprehensive in scope and complete in coverage. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating comprehensive targets. ◦ Carbon emissions target footprint coverage (%) Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company’s emission reduction targets cover its total reported emissions. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates that the targets comprehensively cover all relevant emissions. ◦ Carbon emissions target relevant scope score Definition: Assesses whether the company’s emission reduction targets include all financially material scopes. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates full coverage of financially material emission scopes. ## • Carbon emissions target progress Definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward active environmental targets, as well as its historical track record in meeting previously stated targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong progress towards targets ◦ Carbon emissions ongoing target progress Definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward achieving its emission reduction targets based on current performance. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 all its targets are on track to meet stated targets. ◦ Carbon emissions target track record Definition: Assesses the company’s historical performance in achieving or maintaining sustainability or environmental targets. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance. ## • Carbon emissions target verification Definition: Assesses whether the company’s disclosed targets are supported by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), where applicable. Expressed as either NULL or 10 score, with 10 indicating presence of verification. ◦ SBTi long-term target status Definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) long-term target, aligned with net-zero or long-term decarbonization goals. ◦ SBTi near-term target status Definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) near-term target, aligned with short- to medium-term emissions reduction goals. ## Product Carbon Footprint Exposure score The Product Carbon Footprint Exposure score evaluates the company’s exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business Exposure scores only, except for the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry. For the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry, it is based on the Business Exposure score and the Geographic Exposure score. The Business Exposure score is scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to the Analyzing risk exposure section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formulas are used in the Exposure score calculation: For all industries except the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry: $$ E X P _ { P C F , i } = B U S _ { P C F , i } $$ Where: $E X P _ { P C F , i }$ is the Product Carbon Footprint Exposure score of company i. $B U S _ { P C F , i }$ is the Business Exposure score of company i. ## Exhibit 2: Exposure score components for all industries except the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry 敞口组成图所在官方原件页：产品碳足迹，第11页（图页见本议题结构化正文；官网来源：https://www.msci.com/downloads/documents/access/sustainability-and-climate-resources-and-disclosures/msci-sustainability-and-climate-methodologies/esg-ratings/esg-key-issue-methodologies/environmental-pillar/product-carbon-footprint-key-issue.pdf） For the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry: $$ E X P _ { P C F , i } = B U S _ { P C F , i } ( 1 + 0 . 1 \big ( G E O _ { P C F , i } - 5 \big ) ) $$ Where: $E X P _ { P C F , i }$ is the Product Carbon Footprint Exposure score of company i. $B U S _ { P C F , i }$ is the Business Exposure score of company i. $G E O _ { P C F , i }$ is the Geographic Exposure score of company i. Exhibit 3: Exposure score components for the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry 敞口组成图所在官方原件页：产品碳足迹，第12页（图页见本议题结构化正文；官网来源：https://www.msci.com/downloads/documents/access/sustainability-and-climate-resources-and-disclosures/msci-sustainability-and-climate-methodologies/esg-ratings/esg-key-issue-methodologies/environmental-pillar/product-carbon-footprint-key-issue.pdf） ## Business Exposure score The Business Exposure score is a weighted average of the Business Segment Exposure scores of a company’s business segments. For the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry, scores are weighted by a company’s number of vehicle units sold of a particular vehicle class compared to a company’s total number of vehicle units sold, using the following formula to calculate the Business Exposure score: ## For industries except automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry: $$ B U S _ { P C F , i } = \sum _ { j = 1 } ^ { n _ { i } } w _ { R e v e n u e , i , j } B S E _ { P C F , j } $$ Where: $B U S _ { P C F , i }$ is the Business Exposure score for company i. $B S E _ { P C F , j }$ is the Business Segment Exposure score for business segment j. $w _ { R e v e n u e , i , j }$ is the weight of business segment for company based on the contribution to total company revenue. $n _ { i }$ is the number of business segments of company i. For the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry: $$ B U S _ { P C F , i } = \sum _ { k = 1 } ^ { n _ { i } } w _ { V e h i c l e U n i t s , i , k } B S E _ { P C F , k } $$ Where: $B U S _ { P C F , i }$ is the Business Exposure score for company i. $B S E _ { P C F , k }$ is the Business Segment Exposure score for vehicle class segment k. $w _ { V e h i c l e U n i t s , i , k }$ is the weight derived from vehicle class segment units sold for company based on the contribution to total vehicle units sold for company i. $n _ { i }$ is the number of geographic or vehicle class segments for company i. For other industries, scores are weighted by the proportion of a company’s total revenue in each business segment, using the following formula to calculate the Business Exposure score: ## Business Segment Exposure scores The Business Segment Exposure score is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. Each business activity score is determined by the upstream greenhouse gas emissions intensities of the business activity: ## For industries except automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry: $$ B S E _ { P C F , j } = G H G _ { U p s t r e a m . j } $$ Where: $B S E _ { P C F , j }$ is the Business Segment Exposure score for business activity j. $G H G _ { U p s t r e a m . j }$ is the Upstream Greenhouse Gas Emissions score for business activity j. ## For the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry: Each business activity score is determined by a qualitative assessment of specific vehicle class emissions and vehicle weights in a business activity. The highest resulting Business Exposure scores correspond to the passenger vehicle classes with the highest emissions intensities and vehicle weights. Passenger vehicle classes are generally considered to face stricter regulations than commercial vehicles or two-wheelers. ## Geographic Exposure score The Geographic Exposure score is the weighted average of the Geographic Exposure scores of the countries and regions in which a company operates. Scores are weighted by the proportion of a company’s total revenue in each geographic segment using the following equation: $$ G E O _ { P C F , i } = \sum _ { r = 1 } ^ { n _ { i } } w _ { R e v e n u e , i , r } G S E _ { P C F , r } $$ Where: $G E O _ { P C F , i }$ is the Geographic Exposure score for company i. $G S E _ { P C F , r }$ is the Geographic Segment Exposure score in region . $w _ { R e v e n u e , i , r }$ is the weight of total revenue in region r for company i. $n _ { i }$ is the number of geographic segments for company i. For geographic segments reported as regions (example: Asia Pacific), a nominal GDP-weighted country aggregation is used to calculate region-level scores, using the following equation: $$ G S E _ { P C F , r } = \sum _ { c = 1 } ^ { n _ { r } } w _ { G D P , r , c } G S E _ { P C F , c } $$ Where: $G S E _ { P C F , r }$ is the Geographic Segment Exposure score in region . $G S E _ { P C F , c }$ is the Geographic Segment Exposure score of country . $w _ { G D P , r , c }$ is the specific weight of country within region . ## Geographic Segment Exposure scores ## For the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry: The Geographic Segment Exposure score is determined by regulatory requirements for vehicle carbon emissions or fuel efficiency in specific locations. Stricter regulatory requirements for vehicle carbon emissions or fuel efficiency indicates higher Geographic Segment Exposure score. ## Data sources The following sources are used to determine the Product Carbon Footprint Business Exposure score: IERS’ Comprehensive Environmental Data Archive (CEDA), Refinitiv, MSCI S&C, company disclosures. ## Contact us ## About MSCI Inc. To learn more, please visit www.msci.com msci.com/contact-us The process for submitting a formal index complaint can be found on the index regulation page of MSCI’s website at: https://www.msci.com/index-regulation. ## About MSCI Sustainability and Climate Products and Services MSCI Sustainability and Climate products and services are provided by MSCI Solutions LLC and certain related entities, and are designed to provide in-depth research, ratings and analysis of environmental, social and governance related business practices to companies worldwide. sections.title_en: Introduction

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Climate Change Vulnerability Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSC S&C’s)1 outputs are determined. Climate Change Vulnerability is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Insurance companies are assessed on the physical risk that climate change may pose to insured assets or individuals.
blocks.content_cn: 本文档提供气候变化脆弱性关键议题组成部分的基本信息，帮助ESG评级用户理解MSCI可持续与气候（MSCI S&C）研究输出的确定方式。气候变化脆弱性是MSCI ESG评级模型中环境支柱下的一个关键议题。保险公司评估内容包括气候变化可能对承保资产或个人构成的物理风险。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of ”ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: • Climate model risk: inadequate climate risk modelling may underestimate or misrepresent future climate-related losses and reserving assumptions.
blocks.content_cn: • 气候模型风险：不充分的气候风险建模可能低估或错误表述未来气候相关损失及准备金假设。

blocks.content: • Liquidity and solvency risk: timing and size of claims impact cash flows and solvency.
blocks.content_cn: • 流动性和偿付能力风险：索赔的时间和规模影响现金流和偿付能力。

blocks.content: • Catastrophe risk: increase in frequency and severity and decrease in predictability of catastrophe losses.
blocks.content_cn: • 巨灾风险：巨灾损失的频率和严重程度上升，可预测性下降。

sections.title_en: Climate Change Vulnerability Key Issue score

blocks.content: The Climate Change Vulnerability Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.
blocks.content_cn: 气候变化脆弱性关键议题得分评估公司对该关键议题风险的敞口程度以及风险管理质量。关键议题得分基于敞口得分和管理得分通过下述公式综合得出。敞口得分与管理得分的结合方式为：敞口水平越高，需要展示的管理能力也越高，才能获得相同的总体关键议题得分。

sections.title_en: Climate Change Vulnerability Practices score

blocks.content: The Climate Change Vulnerability Practices score evaluates the company’s initiatives to integrate climate change considerations into insurance underwriting, including use of climate models, research on physical risk impacts and recognition of increased risk exposure. This score is a component of the Climate Change Vulnerability Management score (excluding controversies) and considers attributes of the company's policies and initiatives. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 气候变化脆弱性实践得分评估公司将气候变化考量纳入保险承保的举措，包括使用气候模型、研究物理风险影响以及识别风险敞口增加。该得分是气候变化脆弱性管理得分（不含争议事件）的组成部分，并考虑公司政策和举措的属性。以0-10分表示，10分表示强有力的举措。

sections.title_en: • Recognition that physical risk of climate change may increase underwriting risks

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company recognizes that the physical risk of climate change may increase underwriting risks.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否认识到气候变化的物理风险可能增加承保风险。

sections.title_en: • Research or exercise to quantify the impact of physical risk on insurance underwriting

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company conducts research or exercises to quantify the impact of physical risk on insurance underwriting, either directly (via primary research) or indirectly (through an industry consortium).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否开展研究或演练以量化物理风险对保险承保的影响，无论是直接（通过自主研究）还是间接（通过行业联盟）。

sections.title_en: • Evidence of using climate change models

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company uses climate change models to inform underwriting decisions.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否使用气候变化模型为承保决策提供信息。

sections.title_en: Climate Change Vulnerability Performance score

blocks.content: The Climate Change Vulnerability Performance score evaluates the company's underwriting performance, based on its three-year average combined ratio. The combined ratio measures an insurer’s underwriting profitability by comparing total claims and expenses to earned premiums. It is expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of profitability.
blocks.content_cn: 气候变化脆弱性绩效得分评估公司的承保绩效，基于其三年平均综合成本率（combined ratio）。综合成本率通过比较总索赔和费用与已赚保费来衡量保险公司的承保盈利能力。以0-10分表示，10分表示最高盈利水平。

sections.title_en: • Underwriting performance based on combined ratio

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's underwriting performance, based on its three-year average combined ratio. The combined ratio measures an insurer’s underwriting profitability by comparing total claims and expenses to earned premiums.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：基于公司三年平均综合成本率评估其承保绩效。综合成本率通过比较总索赔和费用与已赚保费来衡量保险公司的承保盈利能力。

sections.title_en: Climate Change Vulnerability Exposure score

blocks.content: The Climate Change Vulnerability Exposure score evaluates the company’s exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the average of the Business and Company-Specific Exposure scores, combined with the Geographic Exposure score. The Geographic Exposure score functions as a multiplier on the averaged Business and Company-Specific Exposure scores, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business Exposure score, Geographic Exposure score and Company-Specific Exposure score are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to Section 3.2, Analyzing risk exposure, of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 气候变化脆弱性敞口得分评估公司对该关键议题风险的敞口程度。它基于业务敞口得分和公司特定敞口得分的平均值，再结合地理敞口得分计算。地理敞口得分作为平均业务和公司特定敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为-50%至+50%。业务敞口得分、地理敞口得分和公司特定敞口得分均按0-10分制评分，10分对应最高风险，0分对应最低风险。更多细节请参阅《ESG评级方法论》第3.2节"风险敞口分析"。敞口得分按以下公式计算：

Climate Change Vulnerability Exposure score.... .7 Business Exposure score. .8 Business Segment Exposure scores... .. 8 Geographic Exposure score . .. 9 Geographic Segment Exposure scores... .. 9 Company-Specific Exposure score ... . 10 Data sources... . 10 Contact us. ..11 ## Introduction This document provides essential information on the components of the Climate Change Vulnerability Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSC S&C’s)1 outputs are determined. Climate Change Vulnerability is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Insurance companies are assessed on the physical risk that climate change may pose to insured assets or individuals. For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of ”ESG Ratings Methodology.” Exhibit 1: MSCI ESG Key Issue hierarchy
